status: New engineering proposal; awaiting Orchestrator disposition.

sourceInterpretation.calibration: Use the already calibrated SH009 detailed resource in metres. The authored origin, +Y up, and +Z forward remain unchanged.
sourceInterpretation.materialRole: Assign by named geometric function and actual SH009 face/component evidence. Palette slots only corroborate the assigned faces.
sourceInterpretation.driveRecess: Treat both shallow recess assemblies as internal parts of the two stock-budgeted intrinsic drives. Charge zero additional sheet stock. Outer casings and connected supports remain opaque stock.
sourceInterpretation.mountGeometry: Four final detailed components are two paired mirror stations, each an 8-vertex upright and an 8-vertex longitudinal lower member. The native export has exactly the same four vertex arrays and material faces. The preserved creator-family derivative names those structures for its own SH010/SH011 variants; it supports structural vocabulary only. No other hull geometry or physical result enters this ledger.
sourceInterpretation.mountAssignment: R3 fitting specifies two utility mounts but gives no positions. Adopt both SH009 longitudinal support centres as proposed generic empty interface locations. One 140 kg interface assembly is split into two 70 kg point allocations at the mirror stations; the four actual structural mount components are already counted as opaque stock.
unsupported: Original source specification/export and the R3 resource supply no dry mass, density, COM or inertia.
The stock areal loads and intrinsic hardware budgets are adopted project design estimates. Actual material thickness and physical hardware volume remain unspecified.

The two actual structural attachment stations have no recovered slot type, fitting access, clearance, mounted item or equipment purchase. Associating the two utility interfaces with them and distributing their empty hardware mass evenly is a new design decision.

The electrical plant, tank, empty accommodation, controls and empty internal magazine have no recovered individual geometry or mount coordinates. Their point locations use explicitly listed SH009 source vertices as proposed anchors.
No crew person, cargo, fuel, ammunition, paid role kit, additional cabin, or purchased utility is included. Native admission, collision shape, docking, role kit fit and gameplay remain independent.
